_comment: Synthetic chilled-water plant (generator chw_plant_staging, camber.datasets._synthetic; 0.104, #137) -> CAMBER Role mapping. Every column is CAMBER's own: CH_KW is the chiller's electric power in kW (0 when it is off), CHWS_T / CHWR_T the chilled-water supply and return in F and CHW_GPM the chiller's chilled-water flow in gpm, CWS_T / CWR_T the condenser water leaving and returning to the tower in F (blank while the chiller is off), CT_FAN the tower fan speed in %, OAT and WB the outdoor dry-bulb and wet-bulb in F. The scenario column selects one plant per ingest run and is not a point.
